text:
ITEM 1 is a pear (likely Bartlett/Williams-type ripe pear, yellow-green with brown speckles). Pear per 100 g: water ~84, protein ~0.4, fat ~0.1, carb ~15.

ITEM 2 is a smear of pinkish-red residue on the plate, most likely tomato sauce or ketchup traces, or possibly a fruit juice/jam smear. Ketchup per 100 g: water ~65, protein ~1.7, fat ~0.1, carb ~26. Tomato sauce is similar but slightly more watery; since it is a thin, flat smear with no thickness, the amount is negligible, so I use the ketchup-like profile.

1 | pear | 84 | 0.4 | 0.1 | 15
2 | tomato sauce (ketchup residue) | 65 | 1.7 | 0.1 | 26
